_notes: Every story flag and counter in UQM, packed as bit fields (GET_GAME_STATE / SET_GAME_STATE). In Attack on Crateris they are world state, read and written by name.
group is the section heading above the entry in globdata.h (e.g. 'Spathi states'); comment is the source comment for the entry, where there is one.

states.name: SHOFIXTI_MAIDENS
states.comment: Did you find the babes yet?

states.name: BATTLE_SEGUE
states.comment: Set to 0 in init_xxx_comm() if communications directly follows an encounter. Set to 1 in init_xxx_comm() if the player gets to decide whether to attack or talk. Set to 1 in communication when battle follows the communication. It is still valid when uninit_xxx_comm() gets called after combat or communication.

states.name: PLANETARY_CHANGE
states.comment: Flag set to 1 when the planet information for the current world is changed since it was last saved to the starinfo.dat file. Set when picking up bio, mineral, or energy nodes. When there's no current world, it should be 0.

states.name: FOUND_PLUTO_SPATHI
states.comment: 0 - Haven't met Fwiffo. 1 - Met Fwiffo on Pluto, now talking to him. 2 - Met Fwiffo on Pluto, after dialog. 3 - Met Fwiffo, and have reported to the Safe Ones on the Spathi moon that he was either killed, or that you have him on board.

states.name: ARILOU_SPACE
states.comment: 0 if the periodically opening QuasiSpace portal is closed or closing. 1 if the periodically opening QuasiSpace portal is open or opening.

states.name: ARILOU_SPACE_SIDE
states.comment: 0 if in HyperSpace and not just emerged from the periodically opening QuasiSpace portal. 1 if in HyperSpace and just emerged from the periodically QuasiSpace portal (still on the portal). 2 if in QuasiSpace and just emerged from the periodically opening portal (still on the portal). 3 if in QuasiSpace and not just emerged from the periodically opening portal.

states.name: ARILOU_SPACE_COUNTER
states.comment: Keeps track of how far the periodically opening QuasiSpace portal is open. (This determines the image) 0 <= ARILOU_SPACE_COUNTER <= 9 0 means totally closed. 9 means completely open.

states.name: PORTAL_COUNTER
states.comment: Set to 1 when the player opens a QuasiSpace portal. It will then be increased to 10, at which time the portal is completely open. (This determines the image).

states.name: MYCON_FELL_FOR_AMBUSH
states.comment: Set to 1 when the Mycon have been told about Organon and are moving towards it.

states.name: GLOBAL_FLAGS_AND_DATA
states.comment: This state seems to be used to distinguish between different places where one may have an conversation with an alien. Like home world, other world, space. Why this needs 8 bits I don't know. Only specific combinations of bits seem to be used (0, 1, or all bits). A closer investigation is desirable. - SvdB Bit 4 is set when initiating communication with the Ilwrath homeworld by means of a HyperWave Broadcaster. Bit 5 is set when initiating communication with an Ilwrath ship by means of a HyperWave Broadcaster. All bits are cleared when communication is over.

states.name: ULTRON_CONDITION
states.comment: 0 if the Supox still have the Ultron 1 if the Captain has the Ultron, completely broken 2 if the Captain has the Ultron, with 1 fix 3 if the Captain has the Ultron, with 2 fixes 4 if the Captain has the Ultron, completely restored 5 if the Ultron has been returned to the Utwig

states.name: UMGAH_ZOMBIE_BLOBBIES
states.comment: The Umgah have come under the influence of the Talking Pet

states.name: KNOW_UMGAH_ZOMBIES
states.comment: The Captain is aware that something is up with the Umgah

states.name: ROSY_SPHERE_ON_SHIP
states.comment: The Rosy Sphere is aboard the flagship, i.e. It has been acquired from the Druuge, but not yet inserted in the broken Ultron. cf. ROSY_SPHERE

states.name: CHMMR_BOMB_STATE
states.comment: 0 - Nothing is known about the Precursor Bomb. 1 - The captain knows from the Chmmr that some extremely powerful weapon is needed to destroy the Sa-Matra. 2 - Installation of the precursor bomb has started. 3 - Left the starbase after installation of the Precursor bomb.

states.name: PKUNK_SHIP_MONTH
states.comment: The month in PKUNK_SHIP_YEAR that new ships are available from the Pkunk.

states.name: PKUNK_SHIP_DAY
states.comment: The day of the month in PKUNK_SHIP_MONTH in PKUNK_SHIP_YEAR that new ships are available.

states.name: PKUNK_SHIP_YEAR
states.comment: The year that new ships are available from the Pkunk (stored as an offset from the year the game starts).

states.name: THRADD_MISSION
states.comment: 0 if the Thraddash fleet hasn't left the Thraddash home world. 1 if the Thraddash are heading towards Kohr-Ah territory. 2 if the Thraddash are fighting the Kohr-Ah. 3 if the Thraddash are returning from Kohr-Ah territory. 4 if the Thraddash fleet is back at the Thraddash home world.

states.name: ROSY_SPHERE
states.comment: The play has or has had the Rosy Sphere. cf. ROSY_SHERE_ON_SHIP

states.name: ZOQFOT_DISTRESS
states.comment: 0 if the Zoq-Fot-Pik aren't in distress 1 if the Zoq-Fot-Pik are under attack by the Kohr-Ah 2 if the Zoq-Fot-Pik have been destroyed because of this attack (not by the Kohr-Ah final victory cleansing)

states.name: MELNORME_TECH_STACK
states.comment: MELNORME_TECH_STACK is now unused

states.name: RAINBOW_WORLD0
states.comment: Low byte of a bit array, one bit per rainbow world. Each bit is set if the rainbow world has been visited. The lowest bit is for the first star in the star_array with RAINBOW_DEFINED, and so on.

states.name: RAINBOW_WORLD1
states.comment: High 2 bits of the bit array of which RAINBOW_WORLD0 is the low byte.

states.name: MELNORME_RAINBOW_COUNT
states.comment: The number of rainbow world locations sold to the Melnorme.

states.name: UTWIG_SUPOX_MISSION
states.comment: 0 if the Utwig and Supox fleet haven't left their home world. 1 if the U&S are on their way towards the Kohr-Ah 2 if the U&S are fighting the Kohr-Ah (first 80 days) 3 does not occur 5 if the U&S are returning home. 6 if the U&S are back at their home world.

states.name: KNOW_ABOUT_SHATTERED
states.comment: 0 if the player doesn't known about shattered worlds 1 if the player has encountered a shattered world 2 if the player knows that shatterred worlds are caused by Mycon deep children. 3 if the player has told the Syreen that Mycon Deep Children cause shattered worlds. Proof doesn't have to be presented yet at this time.

states.name: MYCON_KNOW_AMBUSH
states.comment: Set to 1 when the Mycon have been butchered at Organon, just before the remaining Mycon head back home.

states.name: DNYARRI_LIED
states.comment: Set when the Talking Pet tells you his version of their race's history with the Ur-Quan. Cleared once you confront him about this lie.

states.name: PKUNK_MANNER
states.comment: 0 not met the Pkunk 1 fought the Pkunk, but relations are still salvagable. 2 hostile relations with the Pkunk, no way back. 3 friendly relations with the Pkunk

states.name: BOMB_CARRIER
states.comment: 0 when the flagship is not in battle, or it doesn't have the enhanced precursor bomb installed. 1 when the flagship is in battle and the bomb is installed. This determines whether you can flee (if the warp escape unit is installed at all), and whether taking the ship into the Sa-Matra defense structure will trigger the end of the game.
